answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: each identity's rewards wait on an escrow ledge for 26 epochs and unlock only if random peer graders keep scoring its work above a floor. An attacker running a thousand fake agents must fund and operate all of them for weeks before any payout, and once one cluster is caught, a sable slashing flag wipes every unvested balance it holds. The farm's return reaches its nadir exactly as it grows large enough to be noticed.
